_comment: THE CSV CONTRACT, shared by the Python and JavaScript SDKs.
Both repos hold an identical copy of this file and assert their own column
list against it, because `themeparks-backfill` is one command with two
implementations and a customer using both must get one file format.
Before this existed, one SDK wrote 32 columns and the other 41, with
inParkScheduledMinutes against inParkHoursScheduledMinutes, and the test that
claimed to check it was four spot-checks.
